description:
Implement bidirectional sync between private (BenchBox) and public (BenchBox-public)
repositories. This is a redesign after the previous implementation failed due to:
- Building separate filtering logic that ignored DOCS_DIR_EXCLUDES, CLAUDE_DIR_EXCLUDES
- Copying files without committing them
- No awareness of which version was newer
- Silently overwriting public repo changes

The new design reuses existing prepare_release.py infrastructure and always commits
after sync operations.
